notes: The first-run tour now runs exactly once: it is armed by its own content revision (WELCOME_VERSION), not the app version, so a new release no longer re-shows it, and the skip message is honest about that
History now has a search and filter: narrow sessions by exercise name and by an inclusive date range, with a Clear button that restores the full list
Your whole log can now be copied back into a notes app in one go: a Copy notes button exports every session shown - all of them, or the date range you filter to - in your own shorthand
